resources.string: Shows a small dot above the keyboard. Tap it to dictate; the text is copied to the clipboard.

VoiceX uses this service only to notice when a keyboard is open, so it can show its dictation dot just above it.

Privacy: VoiceX does not read, store or send anything on your screen. It looks only at whether a keyboard window is open and where it is. Speech is transcribed entirely on this phone and never leaves it.

The one exception is the optional Auto-paste setting (off by default): after you dictate, VoiceX inserts the text into the field you are typing in. Nothing else is read or kept.
